crossRefs.note: I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to Yahweh’s house!”
Let’s acknowledge Yahweh. Let’s press on to know Yahweh. As surely as the sun rises, Yahweh will appear. He will come…
The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech, and their men, to entreat Yahweh’s favor,
crossRefs.keyword: pray before the Lord. Heb. intreat the face of the Lord

crossRefs.note: Praise Yahweh, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise Yahweh, my soul!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh, my soul.
While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

translations.web: and the inhabitants of one shall go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of Yahweh, and to seek Yahweh of Armies. I will go also.’
translations.bsb: and the residents of one city will go to another, saying: ‘Let us go at once to plead before the LORD and to seek the LORD of Hosts. I myself am going.’
translations.kjv: And the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to pray before the LORD, and to seek the LORD of hosts: I will go
translations.asv: and the inhabitants of one city shall go to another, saying, Let us go speedily to entreat the favor of Jehovah, and to seek Jehovah of hosts: I will go also.
